items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The house party at Mildred Bailey's house and Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey and John Hammond organizing the session.

ctx.x: The house party at Mildred Bailey's house and Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey and John Hammond organizing the session. Then later Goodman became a bandleader and kept a steady group together on the road and hired me to come along with the trio along with Gene Krupa and later on, a quartet with Lionel Hampton.
And I think we finished Colorado Springs -- we were talking about the Seven Lively Arts show, which I did, with Bert Lahr.
